fusions.name: Mouthful
fusions.desc: Takes a mouthful out of the target, which deals 8 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Overturned Cauldron
fusions.desc: Tips out a pot of boiling stew, which deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and ignores resistance. You restore 10 health.

fusions.name: Everyone Eats
fusions.desc: Serves a meal off the back of your shell: restores 16 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Full Larder
fusions.desc: The moment you are back at full health, the surplus is stored as a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
